provenance: Found in an offline review of the packet on 2026-10-15 (scripts plus reading). check_id names the in-app check that is meant to catch the same issue automatically. Estimated effects are linear: change x return_versions[v3].tax_effect_rates.

findings.title: RSU sales taxed with $0 basis; supplemental statement shows real basis
findings.detail: Broker 1099-B shows blank basis for noncovered RSU lots N1, N3, N4. Corvane supplemental statement gives adjusted basis 19,100 / 19,100 / 9,420. The 2025 vests (38,200) are already in W-2 box 1 (box 14 RSU 38,200), so the gain is taxed twice.

findings.title: Northlake sweep interest counted twice
findings.detail: The composite 1099 (D28) and the standalone Northlake Bank 1099-INT (D29) report the same 1,840 for the same account ending 7731. The 2024 return reported it once.

findings.title: 1099-K amount added on top of income already in the books
findings.detail: Gross receipts = books 151,300 + 1099-K 12,400. The books' deposit detail says the 12,400 Paywell card payments are part of Atlas's 41,200, which is also on Atlas's 1099-NEC. Books reconcile: 1099-NECs 142,000 + small clients 9,300 = 151,300.

findings.title: Mileage log page 3 is a second scan of page 2
findings.detail: Page 3 is printed as a second scan of the May-Aug sheet and is cut off with no total, yet a 3,700 page total was extracted for it. Business miles should be 8,100, not 11,800.

findings.title: Little Sprouts tax ID misread (digits transposed)
findings.detail: Printed tax ID 74-3829156; extracted 74-3829516 at 0.97 confidence. Carried onto Form 2441.

findings.title: Swedish interest converted at the 2024 exchange rate
findings.detail: SEK 18,450 converted at 10.56 (2024 average). The 2025 average is 9.86: 1,871 USD instead of 1,747.

findings.title: Mortgage payoff interest counted twice
findings.detail: Lonestar 1098 box 1 (13,900) already includes interest paid at payoff; the payoff statement says so. The engine also added the payoff statement's 2,150.

findings.title: Seller's share of property tax deducted by buyer
findings.detail: The buyer closing statement credits 6,912 for 2025 county taxes for 01/01-07/07 (seller's period). Deductible home real estate tax is 13,420 - 6,912 = 6,508.

findings.title: Car donation valued at the client's estimate, not the sale price
findings.detail: Client estimated 6,000 (Kelley Blue Book). The 1098-C shows the charity sold the car for 2,900; the deduction is limited to gross proceeds.

findings.title: Self-employed health insurance deducted although Erik was eligible on Ngozi's plan
findings.detail: Questionnaire: Erik was eligible for coverage through Ngozi's employers. The 2024 return took no deduction for the same reason.

findings.title: California taxed Halvorsen wages earned after the move to Texas
findings.detail: W-2 box 16 (111,300) reflects payroll keeping California as work state through 09/30 by mistake. The July paystub shows California wages of 22,469 through 07/15. Residency ended 07/14.

findings.title: Crypto lot C6 reported with zero basis
findings.detail: Client says the BTC was bought 03/15/2021 for about 3,050 on another exchange (bank statement line). That makes the lot long-term with 3,050 basis.

findings.title: Meridian page 32 sale missing
findings.detail: Summary proceeds 71,965 vs extracted lots 71,715. The unread page 32 holds lot M18: proceeds 250, basis 310, short-term noncovered.

findings.title: Phone and internet deducted at 100%; Spotify is personal
findings.detail: Call notes: phone about 70% business, internet about 50%, Spotify Family booked by mistake.

findings.title: Q4 federal estimate: client said 4,000, IRS shows 3,000
findings.detail: The engine used the client's answer ('4,000 I think'). The IRS transcript shows 3,000 on 2026-01-15.

findings.title: California 09/15 payment was applied to 2024, not 2025
findings.detail: The Web Pay confirmation designates the 09/15/2025 3,500 payment for tax year 2024; the FTB account holds it as a 2024 credit. 2025 estimates are 10,500, not 14,000.

findings.title: Theo's SSN in the organizer does not match his card or the 2024 return
findings.detail: Organizer ends 3309; Social Security card and the 2024 return end 3390. Will cause an e-file rejection.

findings.title: Care provider name on Form 2441 does not match the document
findings.detail: Form shows 'Bright Oak Preschool'; the statement and the 2024 return say 'Bright Oak Kids Club'.

findings.title: Due diligence (Form 8867) not completed for the child credits
findings.detail: Child tax credit and credit for other dependents are claimed; the firm requires documented due diligence.

findings.title: HVAC replacement treated as a repair
findings.detail: Whole system replaced (new heat pump, air handler, line set, permit). Likely an improvement depreciated over 27.5 years. Engine what-if: +3,633 federal, +896 California.

findings.title: SEP contribution exceeds the deductible limit
findings.detail: 18,000 contributed; limit about 15,214. The excess (about 2,786) is subject to a 6% excise each year unless withdrawn by the due date.

findings.title: Home office area differs from last year
findings.detail: Measured 220 sq ft (Sacramento) and 260 sq ft (Austin from 07/16); the prior preparer used 300 and left it as an open item.

findings.title: Handwritten St. Brigid receipt: first digit ambiguous
findings.detail: Read as 1,500 at 0.41 confidence; could be 7,500. Client says 1,500 matching check #2207: verify to the bank statement.

findings.title: Questionnaire says no investment sales; documents show 294
findings.detail: 282 brokerage sales and 12 crypto disposals contradict qa-14 and qa-15. Confirm with the client that nothing else is missing.

findings.title: Client says no prior IRA basis; records show 7,000
findings.detail: qa-31 says the backdoor Roth started in 2025, but the 2024 Form 5498 and 2024 Form 8606 show a 7,000 contribution for 2024. The engine used the records (correct); confirm with the client.

findings.title: 2023 Form 3520 for the Swedish inheritance was never resolved
findings.detail: The account was opened 09/2023 from an inheritance above 100,000 USD. The prior preparer left this as an open item with no resolution note.

findings.title: Contractors paid 600 or more without Forms 1099-NEC
findings.detail: Mara Quintero 4,800 and Dev Patel 2,600, both by ACH. Outside the engagement; advise the client.
